svg.text: Test games of the model's own training distribution
Every prefix is one history h
Replay h with the Othello rules engine
Feed the SAME history to the model
Accepted moves A(h) = model's top k squares
k = number of truly legal moves
L(h) and A(h) for every history
up to 2,000 (more games if fewer than 500)
after only one of the two histories
share of boundary moves (legal after only one)
the model does not separate correctly
D2 score = 1 minus the mean of the two errors
